query:
SELECT year, community_area, primary_type, arrest,
    count(*) AS incident_count
    WHERE year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2026
    GROUP BY year, community_area, primary_type, arrest
    ORDER BY year, community_area, primary_type, arrest
notes: Rows are grouped counts, not individual incidents.
Blank community_area values are retained for Chicago-wide totals.
The CSV can be used without an API token or backend.
